Marc Jacobs Perfect Eau de Parfum 50ml is a bright, modern and feminine fragrance with fresh fruity, floral and creamy woody accords. Rhubarb and narcissus create a lively opening, while almond milk adds softness and cedarwood with cashmeran gives the scent a smooth, comforting finish.

  • Top Notes: Rhubarb, Narcissus
  • Heart Note: Almond Milk
  • Base Notes: Cedarwood, Cashmeran

Barcode: 3614227086029

Marc Jacobs Perfect Elixir Eau de Parfum 10ml Miniature is a warm, sensual and feminine fragrance with fruity, floral and gourmand accords. Juicy plum and rhubarb lead into a rich floral heart, while vanilla, amber and smooth woods create a soft, luxurious finish. The 10ml miniature size is ideal for travel or gifting.

  • Top Notes: Plum, Rhubarb
  • Heart Notes: Floral Accords
  • Base Notes: Vanilla, Amber, Woods

Barcode: 3616305264022

Short Product Description

Al Haramain’s current catalogue classifies White Edition as Oriental & Floral and For Her.
